cases.title: The notes can't be read: one sentence about it, then a first lesson, nothing said before the snapshot

rubric.reason: Nothing is said before the snapshot call, and the opening says once, plainly, "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons" with no file, field or error code; it then goes on to a first lesson on this comp by proposing Title in Mentor Practice.

Every name the mentor uses (Mentor Practice, Title, its three Position moves and its Scale move) matches the snapshot's comp and pairs, and "eased" follows from those pairs being targets rather than ease_first leave-outs.
The mentor asks rather than claims ("Since I can't check from my notes, have you already done easing, or would you like to do that first?") and never says the learner hasn't learned easing.

The mentor's first words, after the snapshot call, are the snapshot's plain message about the notes ("I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons. They're kept as they were, and I'll start new notes from this lesson."), said once with no file, field or error code. It then opens a first lesson on Mentor Practice by checking the easing prerequisite rather than stopping.
The only name the mentor mentions is the comp "Mentor Practice", which matches comp.name in the snapshot result; no layers, properties or times are invented.
The mentor says "I don't know whether you've done easing yet. Have you?", asking instead of claiming the learner hasn't learned easing.
